= CodeRay options showcase
:source-highlighter: coderay

Table line numbers with callouts.

[source,ruby,linenums]
----
puts 'one' # <1>
puts 'two'
----
<1> First line.

Inline line numbers starting at five with a highlighted line.

:coderay-linenums-mode: inline

[source,ruby,linenums,start=5,highlight=6]
----
puts 'five'
puts 'six'
puts 'seven'
----

:coderay-linenums-mode: table
:coderay-css: style

Inline styles instead of classes.

[source,ruby]
----
puts 'styled'
----
